text: 指着秃子骂和尚——借题发挥
pinyin: zhǐ zhe tū zi mà hé shang —— jiè tí fā huī
literal: point · at · bald man · scold · monk — borrow · topic · expand
natural: Pointing at a bald man to curse a monk

meaning.en: Using one subject as a pretext to attack another.
meaning.zh: 指着秃子骂和尚，比喻借一件事来影射、攻击别人。

examples.zh: 他指着秃子骂和尚，借题发挥批评我。
examples.en: He used the topic to take a dig at me.

examples.zh: 别指着秃子骂和尚，有话直说。
examples.en: Don't make veiled digs; say it directly.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 整筐丢西瓜，满地拾芝麻——大处不算小处算
pinyin: zhěng kuāng diū xī guā, mǎn dì shí zhī má —— dà chù bù suàn xiǎo chù suàn
parts: 整筐丢西瓜，满地拾芝麻
literal: whole · basket · throw away · watermelon, all · over · ground · pick up · sesame — big · place · not · count · small · place · count
natural: Dropping a basket of melons while picking up sesame seeds

meaning.en: Careless about big things, fussy about small ones.
meaning.zh: 大东西随便丢，小东西却斤斤计较，比喻因小失大。

equivalents: strain at a gnat and swallow a camel

examples.zh: 整筐丢西瓜，满地拾芝麻，他是大处不算小处算。
examples.en: He neglects the big things and fusses over the small.

examples.zh: 整筐丢西瓜，满地拾芝麻，这样管账不行。
examples.en: Managing accounts like this won't do.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 针毡上睡觉——坐卧不宁
pinyin: zhēn zhān shàng shuì jiào —— zuò wò bù níng
literal: needle · felt · on · sleep — sit · lie · not · calm
natural: Sleeping on a bed of needles

meaning.en: Restless and anxious, unable to settle.
meaning.zh: 睡在针毡上难以安睡，比喻心神不宁。

examples.zh: 等结果的这几天，我像针毡上睡觉，坐卧不宁。
examples.en: While waiting for the result I was on pins and needles.

examples.zh: 针毡上睡觉——坐卧不宁，他整晚没合眼。
examples.en: He didn't sleep a wink.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 照葫芦画瓢——按老样子做
pinyin: zhào hú lu huà piáo —— àn lǎo yàng zi zuò
literal: follow · gourd · draw · ladle — according · old · pattern · do
natural: Drawing a ladle by copying a gourd

meaning.en: Imitating mechanically, without originality.
meaning.zh: 照着葫芦画瓢，比喻只会模仿，没有创新。

examples.zh: 新手先照葫芦画瓢，慢慢才有自己的风格。
examples.en: Beginners copy first, and develop their own style later.

examples.zh: 你别只会照葫芦画瓢，要动脑筋。
examples.en: Don't just copy; use your head.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 照猫画虎——差不离
pinyin: zhào māo huà hǔ —— chà bù lí
literal: follow · cat · draw · tiger — differ · not · far
natural: Drawing a tiger by copying a cat: near enough

meaning.en: Copying a model roughly; the result is similar but not exact.
meaning.zh: 照着猫画老虎，样子相近，比喻模仿，大致相似。

examples.zh: 他照猫画虎做了一个，看起来差不离。
examples.en: He made a copy by imitation and it looks close enough.

examples.zh: 照猫画虎——差不离，别太挑剔。
examples.en: It's close enough; don't be too picky.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 赵括徒读父书——纸上谈兵
pinyin: zhào kuò tú dú fù shū —— zhǐ shàng tán bīng
literal: Zhao Kuo · merely · read · father's · book — paper · on · discuss · soldiers
natural: Zhao Kuo merely read his father's books

meaning.en: Theorising without practical experience.
meaning.zh: 赵括只会读兵书，不懂实战，比喻空谈理论、不切实际。

examples.zh: 他只会赵括徒读父书，纸上谈兵，遇事就慌。
examples.en: He's all theory and panics when things happen.

examples.zh: 赵括徒读父书——纸上谈兵，没实践经验不行。
examples.en: Without practical experience you won't get far.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. From the Warring States story in 《史记》 of Zhao Kuo, who lost the Battle of Changping.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。典出《史记》赵括长平之战的故事。

text: 找木匠补锅——找错了人
pinyin: zhǎo mù jiàng bǔ guō —— zhǎo cuò le rén
literal: seek · carpenter · mend · pot — find · wrong · (particle) · person
natural: Asking a carpenter to mend a pot

meaning.en: Asking the wrong person for the job.
meaning.zh: 木匠不会补锅，比喻找错了人。

examples.zh: 你让我修电脑，那是找木匠补锅。
examples.en: Asking me to fix a computer is asking the wrong person.

examples.zh: 找木匠补锅，找错了人，他根本不懂这个。
examples.en: You asked the wrong person; he doesn't know this.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 张小泉的剪刀——名不虚传
pinyin: zhāng xiǎo quán de jiǎn dāo —— míng bù xū chuán
literal: Zhang Xiaoquan · 's · scissors — fame · not · empty · passed on
natural: Zhang Xiaoquan's scissors: the fame is deserved

meaning.en: Living up to its reputation.
meaning.zh: 张小泉剪刀是名牌老字号，比喻名副其实。

equivalents: every bit as good as its reputation

examples.zh: 这家店的菜张小泉的剪刀，名不虚传。
examples.en: The food at this restaurant lives up to its reputation.

examples.zh: 张小泉的剪刀——名不虚传，真锋利。
examples.en: Truly as sharp as its name suggests.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Zhang Xiaoquan is a famous scissors brand from Hangzhou.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。张小泉是杭州著名剪刀品牌。

text: 张飞遇李逵——黑对黑
pinyin: zhāng fēi yù lǐ kuí —— hēi duì hēi
literal: Zhang Fei · meet · Li Kui — black · against · black
natural: Zhang Fei meets Li Kui: black versus black

meaning.en: Two equally fierce or alike opponents face off.
meaning.zh: 张飞和李逵都是黑脸猛将，比喻两个同样厉害的人相遇。

examples.zh: 这场比赛张飞遇李逵，黑对黑，谁也不让谁。
examples.en: In this match, two equals met and neither gave way.

examples.zh: 张飞遇李逵——黑对黑，打得难解难分。
examples.en: An even fight with no clear winner.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Zhang Fei (《三国演义》) and Li Kui (《水浒传》) are both known as dark-faced warriors.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。张飞和李逵都以黑脸猛将著称。

text: 张飞妈妈姓吴——无事（吴氏）生非（飞）
pinyin: zhāng fēi mā ma xìng wú —— wú shì (wú shì) shēng fēi (fēi)
literal: Zhang Fei · mum · surname · Wu — no · matter (Wu clan) · stir up · wrong (Fei)
natural: Zhang Fei's mother is a Wu: making trouble from nothing

meaning.en: Stirring up trouble out of nothing.
meaning.zh: 吴氏生张飞，谐“无事生非”，比喻无事找事。

examples.zh: 别张飞妈妈姓吴，无事生非了。
examples.en: Stop making trouble out of nothing.

examples.zh: 张飞妈妈姓吴——无事生非，真让人头疼。
examples.en: Making trouble for no reason; what a headache.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 吴氏生飞 (wúshì shēng Fēi, 'Lady Wu bore Fei') sounds like 无事生非 (wúshì shēngfēi, 'make trouble from nothing').
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“吴氏生飞”谐“无事生非”。

text: 炸药的捻子——一点就着
pinyin: zhà yào de niǎn zi —— yī diǎn jiù zháo
literal: explosive · 's · fuse — one · touch · then · catch fire
natural: An explosive's fuse: lights at a touch

meaning.en: Quick to flare up in anger.
meaning.zh: 炸药捻子一点就燃，比喻脾气暴躁，一触即发。

examples.zh: 他是炸药的捻子，一点就着，你别惹他。
examples.en: He has a short fuse; don't provoke him.

examples.zh: 炸药的捻子——一点就着，说话小心点。
examples.en: Watch what you say; he flares up easily.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 炸了窝的马蜂——乱哄哄
pinyin: zhà le wō de mǎ fēng —— luàn hōng hōng
literal: burst · (particle) · nest · 's · wasp — messy · buzzing
natural: Wasps whose nest has been disturbed: buzzing chaos

meaning.en: A noisy, chaotic scene.
meaning.zh: 马蜂窝被捅，马蜂乱飞，比喻场面嘈杂混乱。

examples.zh: 教室里炸了窝的马蜂，乱哄哄的。
examples.en: The classroom is pure pandemonium.

examples.zh: 消息一出，大家像炸了窝的马蜂。
examples.en: When the news came out everyone went into uproar.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 贼娃子说梦话——不打自招
pinyin: zéi wá zi shuō mèng huà —— bù dǎ zì zhāo
literal: thief · lad · talk · dream · words — not · beaten · self · confess
natural: A thief talking in his sleep: confessing unprompted

meaning.en: Giving oneself away without being pressed.
meaning.zh: 贼在梦里说出实情，比喻无意中暴露自己。

equivalents: let the cat out of the bag

examples.zh: 他贼娃子说梦话，不打自招，把秘密说出来了。
examples.en: He gave himself away and spilled the secret.

examples.zh: 贼娃子说梦话——不打自招，真是自己露馅。
examples.en: He let his own secret slip.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 贼去了才关门——错过时机
pinyin: zéi qù le cái guān mén —— cuò guò shí jī
literal: thief · gone · only · shut · door — miss · pass · timing
natural: Shutting the door only after the thief has gone

meaning.en: Acting too late to prevent the damage.
meaning.zh: 贼走了才关门，比喻事后补救，已经晚了。

equivalents: lock the stable door after the horse has bolted

examples.zh: 出了事才加强管理，贼去了才关门。
examples.en: Tightening management only after the incident is locking the stable door after the horse has bolted.

examples.zh: 贼去了才关门，已经来不及了。
examples.en: It's too late to do anything about it.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 灶王爷贴在腿肚子上——人走家搬
pinyin: zào wáng yé tiē zài tuǐ dù zi shàng —— rén zǒu jiā bān
literal: Kitchen God · stuck · on · calf — person · go · home · move
natural: Kitchen God stuck on a calf: wherever one goes, home goes too

meaning.en: Someone with no fixed home who takes everything with them.
meaning.zh: 灶王爷贴在腿上，人走到哪家就搬到哪，比喻居无定所。

examples.zh: 他常年出差，灶王爷贴在腿肚子上，人走家搬。
examples.en: He's always on the road, with his home wherever he goes.

examples.zh: 灶王爷贴在腿肚子上——人走家搬，没个固定地方。
examples.en: Always moving, with no fixed home.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 早晨的天，婆婆的脸——说变就变
pinyin: zǎo chén de tiān, pó po de liǎn —— shuō biàn jiù biàn
literal: morning · 's · sky, mother-in-law · 's · face — say · change · then · change
natural: Morning sky, mother-in-law's face: changes in a moment

meaning.en: Mood or weather that changes without warning.
meaning.zh: 早晨的天气和婆婆的脸色，说变就变。

examples.zh: 早晨的天，婆婆的脸，说变就变，你得小心。
examples.en: Morning skies and mothers-in-law change in a flash; be careful.

examples.zh: 早晨的天，婆婆的脸——说变就变。
examples.en: As changeable as can be.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 砸开的核桃——有人（仁）儿
pinyin: zá kāi de hé táo —— yǒu rén (rén) r
literal: smash · open · 's · walnut — have · kernel (person)
natural: A cracked walnut has a kernel

meaning.en: A pun: 'has kernel' (有仁儿) hints at 'has people/talent' (有人儿).
meaning.zh: 核桃砸开有仁儿，谐“有人”，比喻有人才、有人可用。

examples.zh: 这个团队砸开的核桃，有人儿，不用愁。
examples.en: This team has good people, so no worries.

examples.zh: 砸开的核桃——有人儿，他们不缺人才。
examples.en: They don't lack talent.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 仁 (rén, kernel) sounds like 人 (rén, person).
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“仁”与“人”同音。

text: 杂交的骡子——非驴非马
pinyin: zá jiāo de luó zi —— fēi lǘ fēi mǎ
literal: cross-bred · 's · mule — not · donkey · not · horse
natural: A cross-bred mule: neither donkey nor horse

meaning.en: Neither one thing nor the other.
meaning.zh: 骡子不是驴也不是马，比喻不伦不类。

examples.zh: 这种装修风格杂交的骡子，非驴非马。
examples.en: This decor is neither one thing nor the other.

examples.zh: 杂交的骡子——非驴非马，很难归类。
examples.en: It's hard to classify.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 袁世凯当皇帝——短命的货
pinyin: yuán shì kǎi dāng huáng dì —— duǎn mìng de huò
literal: Yuan Shikai · become · emperor — short · life · 's · goods
natural: Yuan Shikai playing emperor: short-lived

meaning.en: Something that does not last.
meaning.zh: 袁世凯称帝仅八十多天，比喻存在时间极短的事物。

examples.zh: 这个新品牌像袁世凯当皇帝，短命的货。
examples.en: This new brand was short-lived.

examples.zh: 袁世凯当皇帝——短命的货，不会长久。
examples.en: It won't last long.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Yuan Shikai proclaimed himself emperor in 1915–16 and the regime lasted about 83 days.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。袁世凯1915年称帝，仅八十多天。

text: 雨天背稻草——越背越重
pinyin: yǔ tiān bēi dào cǎo —— yuè bēi yuè zhòng
literal: rainy · day · carry · straw — more · carry · more · heavy
natural: Carrying straw in the rain: heavier and heavier

meaning.en: A burden that keeps growing.
meaning.zh: 稻草淋雨吸水，背着越来越重，比喻负担越来越重。

examples.zh: 欠的债雨天背稻草，越背越重。
examples.en: The debt is a load that grows heavier each day.

examples.zh: 雨天背稻草——越背越重，压力越来越大。
examples.en: The pressure keeps mounting.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 愚公移山——非一日之功
pinyin: yú gōng yí shān —— fēi yī rì zhī gōng
literal: Yu Gong · move · mountains — not · one · day · 's · effort
natural: Yu Gong moving mountains: not done in a day

meaning.en: Great undertakings take long perseverance.
meaning.zh: 愚公移山靠世世代代坚持，比喻大事需要长期努力。

equivalents: Rome wasn't built in a day

examples.zh: 愚公移山，非一日之功，要有耐心。
examples.en: Moving mountains takes time, so be patient.

examples.zh: 建设一流大学愚公移山——非一日之功。
examples.en: Building a top university can't be done overnight.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. Story from 《列子·汤问》 about the Foolish Old Man who moved mountains.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。出自《列子·汤问》愚公移山的故事。

text: 愚公的住处——开门见山
pinyin: yú gōng de zhù chù —— kāi mén jiàn shān
literal: Yu Gong · 's · dwelling — open · door · see · mountain
natural: Yu Gong's home: open the door and see the mountain

meaning.en: Getting straight to the point.
meaning.zh: 愚公家门口就是大山，比喻说话直截了当。

examples.zh: 他是愚公的住处，开门见山，有话直说。
examples.en: He gets straight to the point and says what he thinks.

examples.zh: 愚公的住处——开门见山，他说话从不绕弯。
examples.en: He never beats about the bush.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。

text: 俞伯牙摔琴——不谈（弹）了
pinyin: yú bó yá shuāi qín —— bù tán (tán) le
literal: Yu Boya · smash · zither — not · discuss (play) · (particle)
natural: Yu Boya smashing his zither: no more playing

meaning.en: A pun: 'no more playing' that hints at 'no more talking'.
meaning.zh: 俞伯牙知音死后摔琴，谐“不弹了”为“不谈了”，比喻不再商量、不再继续。

examples.zh: 既然谈不拢，俞伯牙摔琴，不谈了。
examples.en: Since we can't agree, no more discussion.

examples.zh: 俞伯牙摔琴——不谈了，我们算了吧。
examples.en: No more talk; let's drop it.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous. A pun: 弹 (tán, play) sounds like 谈 (tán, discuss). Story from 《吕氏春秋》 of Bo Ya smashing his zither after Zhong Ziqi died.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。谐音双关：“弹”与“谈”同音。伯牙为钟子期摔琴，典出《吕氏春秋》。

text: 鱼找鱼，虾找虾，乌龟爱王八——气味相投
pinyin: yú zhǎo yú, xiā zhǎo xiā, wū guī ài wáng bā —— qì wèi xiāng tóu
parts: 鱼找鱼，虾找虾，乌龟爱王八
literal: fish · seek · fish, shrimp · seek · shrimp, tortoise · love · turtle — air · taste · mutually · match
natural: Fish seek fish, shrimp seek shrimp: like with like

meaning.en: People with similar tastes gravitate together.
meaning.zh: 各类动物找同类，比喻志趣相投的人聚在一起。

equivalents: birds of a feather flock together

examples.zh: 鱼找鱼，虾找虾，乌龟爱王八，他们俩真是气味相投。
examples.en: Those two are cut from the same cloth.

examples.zh: 鱼找鱼，虾找虾，乌龟爱王八——气味相投。
examples.en: Birds of a feather flock together.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, leaving the listener to supply the punchline. Casual and humorous.
usage.zh: 多只说前半句，后半句由听者自己领会。口语，带诙谐意味。
